resources.string: Tap to lock screen instantly (with biometric unlock)
Allows the Screen Locker widget to lock your screen. This service does NOT read or collect any data from your screen.
Please enable the Screen Locker accessibility service.\n\nGo to Settings → Accessibility → Screen Locker → Enable
✓ Service is active! Add the widget to your home screen.\n\nTapping the widget will lock the screen and fingerprint / face unlock will work immediately.
